expected_response.note: Incumbent pointcloud reward unchanged; no operative parameter edit.

failure_modes: Unsupported edit displacing surrounding coordinates without an evidence-bound expected advantage (joint_diagnostics:2 negative association with observed child score gain).
Treating a diagnostic pair-kernel or moment feature as an independent force the executing pointcloud scalar does not contain (formula_registry diagnostic_limit).
Reading a temporal derivative or curve fit as a spatial gradient or causal benefit (limitations; curve_support).
Interpreting recorded joint-head survival credit as decoded terminal affinity benefit (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available; lineage_support).
Interpreting turnover residual as a causal selection effect or atom velocity (limitations).
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest reproducible signed contrasts are on short-range pair-distance shell densities (endpoint_effects:9, 10, 11; branch_adjusted:163, 164, 240, 241), but the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit; observable_definitions scope). No registered bounded edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) is bound to a pair-kernel observable, so no permitted edit expresses the Analyst's leading hypothesis without treating a diagnostic feature as an independent force the formula does not contain. The stationary coordinate target is the incumbent pointcloud reward; the permitted time-conditioned alternatives (temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) change regional attention or teacher blending at actual score nodes while preserving the same static teacher coordinates and the shared learned support, and the Analyst's temporal evidence (continuous:0, continuous:100; curve_support) shows landmark-specific sign changes with no accepted polynomial and no validated Legendre runtime form, so a time-conditioned edit is not defensibly advantaged over the stationary target. Spatial scales: the landmark radius is 5.0 A and the pair-kernel sigma is 0.75 A (observable_definitions); the short-shell contrasts are observed scales, whereas any pointcloud_delta_A change would be an exploratory curvature choice with no evidence-bound expected response range, and the executing curvature is already the declared default 1 A. Teacher neighborhoods: teacher_neighbors is a count, not a distance bandwidth (formula_registry prior; teacher_modes), and the intact-teacher dispersion and joint-geometry evidence (branch_adjusted:74, 76, 151, 153, 228, 230, 305, 307; joint_diagnostics:14) does not establish that a narrower or broader neighborhood improves mode coverage, so no neighbor-count edit is justified. Centroid coordinates carry no reproducible signed contrast (branch_adjusted:0, 1, 2, 77, 78, 79; endpoint_effects:0, 1, 2), so no region_index edit is supported. Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available; lineage_support; limitations), and turnover residuals are accounting diagnostics (turnover:14, 17, 47, 134, 224, 227, 254, 257, 497, 524, 584), so neither supports an operative edit. Predicted failure response: an unsupported edit would displace surrounding coordinates without an evidence-bound expected advantage, and joint_diagnostics:2 shows selection innovation negatively associated with observed child score gain, so unnecessary displacement is a concrete failure mode; affinity-first priority therefore favors retaining the incumbent. Temperatures are immutable and no temperature edit is proposed.
